hooks.command:
root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0
[ -f "$root/CLAUDE.md" ] || exit 0
grep -q "^## Progress log" "$root/CLAUDE.md" || exit 0
sha=$(git -C "$root" rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null) || exit 0
marker=$(printf '`%s`' "$sha")
grep -qF "$marker" "$root/CLAUDE.md" && exit 0
changed=$(git -C "$root" diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r HEAD 2>/dev/null)
if [ "$changed" = "CLAUDE.md" ]; then
  stray=$(git -C "$root" diff-tree -p --no-commit-id HEAD -- CLAUDE.md 2>/dev/null | grep '^+' | grep -v '^+++' | grep -cvE '^\+- .+ — `[0-9a-f]{7,}` \([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}\)$')
  [ "${stray:-1}" -eq 0 ] && exit 0
fi
printf -- '- %s — %s (%s)\n' "$(git -C "$root" log -1 --pretty=%s)" "$marker" "$(git -C "$root" log -1 --date=short --pretty=%ad)" >> "$root/CLAUDE.md"
